sources.title: Original Order in Council 631/1986: British Columbia Cellulose Company Repeal Act commencement
sources.locator: One-page order; approval block and operative text
sources.verification: Original official PDF downloaded and visually inspected. Operative text expressly effective 31 March 1986; no 1 April or time-of-day wording. Regulation citation 49/86 is supplied independently by CELL-S09.

claims.statement: Original OIC 631/1986, approved 19 March 1986, brings the Repeal Act into force effective 31 March 1986. Section 2 dissolves the company on repeal. The official consolidation identifies B.C. Reg. 49/86.
claims.reasoning: Legal endpoint follows the explicit dissolution-on-repeal clause applied to the effective date in the recovered original commencement order.

claims.statement: The 1985/86 Public Accounts separately state dissolution and transfer effective 1 April 1986, while acknowledging Act commencement on 31 March.
claims.confidence: high that the Accounts print this assertion
claims.treatment: Retain as an attributed assertion alongside the recommended legal endpoint; do not silently normalize the documents or claim a proven typographical error.
claims.unresolved: The reason for the Accounts' next-day dissolution wording remains unexplained. The original order now establishes legal commencement on 31 March 1986.

claims.statement: BC Cellulose acquired 79% on 29 June 1973; the same percentage is observed at 31 December 1975.
claims.graph_recommendation: Separate majority-controlled subsidiary record; do not classify as wholly provincially owned. Public acquisition is not incorporation.

claims.statement: The 1973 transaction combined certain Columbia Cellulose assets and liabilities with Canadian Cellulose, after which Columbia ceased to be its shareholder.
claims.graph_recommendation: Do not collapse these into one entity or model the transaction as a simple rename.

claims.statement: All shares were purchased by BC Cellulose effective 1 March 1974 from Eddy Match; the company also acquired assets and third-party liabilities of Eddy Match operating divisions.
claims.graph_recommendation: Add a wholly owned subsidiary from this public acquisition date; keep incorporation unresolved and do not duplicate the same-named acquired division.
claims.related_accounting_date_note: Parent F7 measures goodwill/equity at acquisition on 28 February; use subsidiary explicit 1 March effective purchase date for the ownership event.

claims.entity: Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited; Kootenay Forest Products Ltd.; Plateau Mills Ltd.
claims.statement: BC Cellulose distributed these securities to the Province before transfer to BCRIC. The precise dividend date remains unknown.
claims.date_bounds_basis: Inferred from fiscal-year 1977/78 transactions and the completed BCRIC transfer on 9 March 1978.
claims.confidence: high for transaction, moderate for inferred bounds
claims.graph_recommendation: Preserve the Province as an intermediate direct owner with a bounded start; do not invent an exact dividend date.

claims.statement: The Province combined 9,570,353 common and 39,750 non-voting shares received from BC Cellulose with 278,100 common shares held separately as a temporary investment. The combined interest transferred to BCRIC was 81%.
claims.graph_recommendation: Retain 79% as BC Cellulose historical holding and 81% as the combined Province/BCRIC transfer observation; do not backdate 81% to the holding-company acquisition.

claims.entity: Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited; Kootenay Forest Products Ltd.; Plateau Mills Ltd.
claims.statement: The Finance Minister reported the actual transfer to BCRIC on 9 March 1978, with holdings of 81%, 100% and 100% respectively.
claims.locator: Hansard 10 April 1978 afternoon, p.264; OIC 530/1978 PDF 1,3–4
claims.evidence_boundary: Hansard provides retrospective completion evidence; the OIC alone supplies approval and agreement date.

claims.entity: British Columbia Resources Investment Corporation and its subsidiaries
claims.statement: The public share issue and Crown note conversion occurred in calendar 1979. The Accounts describe the government interest falling from 100% to below 5%; the exact day of crossing the control threshold is unresolved.
claims.date_bounds_basis: Subsequent-events narrative after the March 1979 accounts plus BCRIC audited comparative cash flows explicitly placing the public cash issue and note conversion in calendar 1979.
claims.confidence: high for year; exact day unresolved
claims.graph_recommendation: End wholly/majority provincial classification at year precision 1979; do not use 1980 amalgamation as public-control endpoint. Retain later minority Crown interest if modeled.

claims.statement: BCRIC increased its ownership from 81% to 100% during 1980, after the 1979 public issue.
claims.locator: p2 / PDF 4; p23 / PDF 25 note 2 continuation
claims.graph_recommendation: Do not describe this as 100% provincial ownership. BCRIC ownership and ultimate Crown ownership differ.

claims.entity: Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited; Kootenay Forest Products Ltd.; Plateau Mills Ltd.
claims.statement: The three companies amalgamated on 31 December 1980 into a new Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited.
claims.graph_recommendation: Record the successor event separately from public-control cessation; do not call it a BC Cellulose rename or infer operational closure.

claims.entity: Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited; Kootenay Forest Products Ltd.
claims.statement: Original incorporation dates were not established in this pass. The recovered exact beginnings are public acquisition dates.
claims.graph_recommendation: Leave incorporation unknown or use separately sourced prior incorporation evidence. Do not promote acquisition dates into legal formation dates.

qa.result: Substantive pass, with update required to replace original-instrument-unrecovered wording: OIC 631/1986 has now been recovered.
qa.suggestion: Explicitly distinguish majority-controlled Canadian Cellulose from wholly owned Kootenay; later 100% BCRIC ownership is not full provincial ownership.

unresolved_items: Reason for the Accounts' 1 April 1986 dissolution wording, despite original legal commencement on 31 March.
Exact dividend date between BC Cellulose and Province before 9 March 1978.
Exact day of BCRIC loss of wholly/majority provincial ownership during 1979.
Original incorporation dates for Canadian Cellulose and Kootenay.
